name: Palestine
summary: Territories comprising the West Bank, East Jerusalem, and the Gaza Strip, as well as the global diaspora of millions of Palestinian refugees displaced during successive regional wars.
historical_context: The Palestinian population has experienced continuous displacement, disenfranchisement, and military occupation starting with the 1948 Nakba (expulsion and flight of over 700,000 Palestinians) and the 1967 Six-Day War (bringing the West Bank, Gaza, and East Jerusalem under Israeli military control). Palestinian refugee populations across Lebanon, Jordan, and Syria have been focal points of regional conflicts, notably the 1982 Sabra and Shatila massacre and internal civil conflicts.
primary_institutions_involved: United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA)
